R452.note: Adds secure: true to the auth cookie and changes nothing else.

R453.note: Moves label and status into Jinja2 variables under default autoescaping; markup structure preserved, Markup() wrapper removed.

R454.note: Pins ValidAlgorithms to HS256, which is the restriction the finding calls for and matches the symmetric key; stated plainly, though it assumes the issuer signs HS256 rather than HS384/512.

R455.note: Rejects field_index >= MAX_FIELDS with the existing -1 error path before the array read; nothing else changes.

R456.note: subtle.ConstantTimeCompare gives exact equality, keeps the empty-header rejection, and meets the stated contract.

R457.note: URI.isAbsolute() rejects scheme-bearing URLs but a protocol-relative value like //evil.com/x has no scheme, passes the check, and the servlet container resolves it to an external host, so the open redirect is only partially closed; the rejection of absolute URLs is the fix itself and is stated.

R458.note: archive/tar removes the shell entirely, but ctx is accepted and never used so request-context cancellation (an explicit contract item) is silently dropped, and compressed archives that GNU tar -tf auto-detected now fail with 500, neither stated.

R459.note: shared_ptr ownership removes the dangling pointer, but the public subscribe(Observer*) signature changes (any other raw-pointer caller breaks) and the static bus now retains every observer forever so scoped observers keep receiving events and memory grows per monitorOnce call; only the lifetime extension is mentioned, not the retention/API consequences.

R460.note: Swapping the hand-built inline command for redis-py hset (RESP, length-prefixed) closes CRLF injection and is stated as a new dependency; minor: only socket_connect_timeout is set so the original 2s socket timeout on I/O is not fully preserved despite the claim.

R461.note: Unseeded SecureRandom replaces the attacker-seeded Random; seed parameter still parsed as before so the error path is unchanged, and dropping the seed's influence is stated.

R462.note: SecureRandom 128-bit base64url token replaces Math.random(); the value format change is stated and the only consumers (cookie and session attribute equality) are unaffected.

R463.note: subprocess.run argument list with stdout/stderr redirected to the same log file reproduces the original redirection without a shell; a leading-dash host could still be read by ping as an option (no -- separator), a lesser residual gap.

R464.note: self.get_object() applies the owner-scoped queryset (404 for others' invoices) and runs IsInvoiceOwner; response shape and staff access preserved per contract.

R465.note: Does not compile: calls order.getUserId() (Order only has getCustomerUsername) and references a nonexistent CustomUserDetails class, so the fix cannot ship and would break the whole service build.

R466.note: Parameterized ? placeholder with (term,) closes the injection and preserves exact-match semantics; search.js left alone per contract.
